translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: 1 Tesalonika
book.title: Akɨnafarir Faragha Zuim,Pol Tesalonikan Nguibamɨn Itir Sios Baghava an Osiri O 1 Tesalonika

content: Pol Tesalonikaba gavgavim me danɨngasa Timoti amada
E ia bagha nɨghnɨghavɨra ikia ghua, gɨn e ghaze, e sughsughan kogham. Egha akam mɨsuegha ghaze, ga Atensɨn ikiam.
Egha Timoti amadazɨma a ia bagha izi. Timoti a en aveghbuam. Egha a Godɨn ingangarir gumazir Kraisɨn Akar Aghuim akurim. Ga gavgavim ia danɨngɨva, ian nɨghnɨzir gavgavimɨn akurvaghasa anemada.
E kamaghɨn aghua, osɨmtɨziba ko mɨzazir ia isir kaba ia damutɨ ia nɨghnɨzir avɨribar amuam. Ia uari fo, God uabɨ osɨmtɨzir kamagh gariba aterasa e amɨsefe.
E faragha ia ko ikia egha kamagh ia mɨgɨavɨra iti, osɨmtɨzitaba e bativam. Ezɨ ia datɨrɨghɨn deragha kamaghɨn fo, dughiar kurar kam e bato.

Bizir kam bagha, kɨ sughsughan aghuagha, ian nɨghnɨzir gavgavim gɨfoghasa Timoti ia bagha anemadazɨ a izi. Kɨ kamagh atiati, gumazir kuram Satan ian nɨghnɨzir gavgavibar amutɨ, da ireghtɨ, en ingangarim pura mangɨgham.
Timoti mɨgɨrɨgɨar aghuim inigha izezɨma Pol bar akonge

Ezɨ Timoti ia ategha datɨrɨghɨra iza e batogha, Akar Aghuim e mɨgɨa ghaze, ia nɨghnɨzir gavgavim Godɨn ikiava God ko gumazir igharazibagh ifonge. Egha a kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, ia zurara e gɨnɨghnɨgha ian naviba bar en dera. Egha ia en ganasava ami moghɨn e uaghan ian ganasava ami.
Kamaghɨn amizɨ, en adarasi, dughiar e osɨmtɨziba ateri nɨghnɨzir avɨriba e bativimɨn, e kamaghɨn oraki, ia nɨghnɨzir gavgavir Godɨn itim ikiavɨra iti; ezɨ bizir kam gavgavim e ganɨngi.
E kamaghɨn fo, ia Ekiam bagha tugha gavgavizɨma, e kagh uaghan, en dabirabim datɨrɨghɨn bar dera.
E ia gɨnɨghnɨgha uan Godɨn damazimɨn guizbangɨra bar akonge. Kamaghɨn amizɨ, e ia bagha God mɨnabavɨra iti.

Egha dɨmagariba ko aruebar, God ko pamtem mɨgɨavɨra ikia ghaze, God en amamangatɨghtɨ e uari izɨ ian ganam. Eghtɨ ian nɨghnɨzir gavgavim oteveghtɨ, e ua ian akurvaghɨva ian nɨghnɨzir gavgavim damutɨma, a gavgavigham.
E kamaghsua, en God en Afeziam uabɨ ko Iesus en Ekiam, e bagh tuavim azeneghtɨ e ia bagh izam.

En ifongiam, Ekiam ia damightɨ arazir igharazir darazigh ifongezim bar moghɨra ia gizɨvagh egh fasfagham. E bar ia gifongezɨ moghɨra, ia vaghvagh Godɨn gumazamiziba ko gumazamizir igharaziba bar me gifongegh.
Eghtɨ God gavgavim ia danɨngtɨ, gumazamizir en Ekiam Iesusɨn damazimɨn zueziba bar, a ko uamateghtɨ, en God en Afeziam ian gantɨma ia an damazimɨn zuegh arazir kuraba puvatɨgham.
